name: print-social-flyer-drive-in-cinema-yellow-blue-diagonal
title: Drive-in cinema flyer with diagonal yellow/blue split
whatItIs: A square flyer for a drive-in cinema, split diagonally into dark, yellow and blue triangular fields, with a line-art car illustration, popcorn photo cutouts and a rounded logo lockup.
whatItMeans: A diagonal color split breaks the usual rectangular grid, giving a simple flyer a sense of motion appropriate to a car/drive-in theme.
techniques: split a square canvas diagonally into contrasting color fields instead of stacking horizontal bands
overlay a cut-out real photo prop (popcorn) atop flat vector shapes for tactile contrast
contain the brand name in a rounded pill/blob logo lockup to soften a geometric layout

vocabulary.definition: a layout technique dividing a canvas along an angled line rather than horizontally or vertically
